_comment: Copy to config/genai.json. Every text, decision and speech purpose runs on OpenAI (put OPENAI_API_KEY in .env at the repository root, or use "credential:NAME" for a systemd credential); every image is painted with ComfyUI behind the GPU broker (docs/gpu-broker.md), which must be running before a world is built. A purpose with no provider is simply off: worlds cannot be built without the world, image and check purposes, and people answer with simple stock replies without npc.decision.

openai._comment: Building worlds: Luna writes and plans; strict structured output enforces each answer's schema while decoding. 'flex' is half price; busy capacity is waited out.

openai-live._comment: Play-time calls (conversations, item legends): the standard tier, for low latency.

openai-decide._comment: OpenAI's decisions endpoint (/v1/decisions): checks of painted art and places.

openai-stt._comment: Speech to text for talking to people.

comfy._comment: The GPU broker in front of ComfyUI (production: the GPU PC's LAN address, with "apiKey": "credential:gpu-broker"). Places, mist and every asset are painted with Krea 2. Assets use the workflow below: Krea paints the subject on the chroma-key backdrop the prompt writer picked and BiRefNet marks it, in one job; the engine cuts it out against the known backdrop and scores the cut. Models: diffusion_models/krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors, background_removal/birefnet.safetensors; places also need Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo, SeedVR2 and the Krea 2 AnyPaint LoRA (docs/places.md).

world.design._comment: Concept, world plan, story, places' plans and checks. strongModel (default gpt-6.1-sol, null turns it off) checks whole paintings, exits and level reviews, at its list price ($2 input, $0.10 cached, $10 output per million tokens; flex halves them).

image.prompt._comment: Writes each asset's Krea prompt and picks its chroma-key backdrop (green, blue or magenta) and, for creatures, the view (front or side).

image.check._comment: Judges each painting's content (subject, framing, pose). The cut itself is scored without a model, against the known backdrop.

spending._comment: Daily budgets for OpenAI in dollars: per player (an administrator can set each player's own on the Users page) and for the whole server. Administrators are unlimited unless given their own budget. Providers may set "pricing": {"inputPerM", "cachedPerM", "outputPerM"}; OpenAI providers default to gpt-6-luna prices.

animation._comment: Actor animation (docs/world-art.md, Characters in motion): a 3D model, rig and clip sheets in eight directions per character and creature, made in the background after the art. Paths are this machine's. python: one with numpy, scipy and Pillow (ComfyUI's embedded Python has them). library: Quaternius' Universal Animation Library (CC0, the glTF from its Unreal-Godot folder). skintokens (optional, for animals and other bodies): a SkinTokens checkout with its own venv; on the GPU it takes a hold on the whole GPU from the broker (about 14 GB), cpu takes 12-18 minutes per creature. pitch: degrees the sprite camera looks down at figures standing on the top-down maps (35, a classic three-quarter view). Leave this block out to keep still images.
